title: IVMS101 Skeleton Validator
description: Structural and code-list validation of an IVMS 101.2023 travel-rule payload supplied as a zero-PII skeleton: every free-text leaf must be the literal SYNTHETIC or a {"len": n} max-length marker; country, name, address and identifier type codes are validated against the pinned code lists; required entities, cardinality, max lengths, the declared edition and the C1-C12 constraints are checked per the pinned standard. Output is paths, rule ids and verdicts only - the tool never echoes a leaf value, and any free-text leaf holding other content is refused by path. ISO-3166 and GLEIF Registration Authority lists are checked at format level; the C2 date-in-past rule is evaluated against the pinned 2026-11-01 build date, not a runtime clock.

ivms101_edition.description: Declared IVMS 101 edition; must equal the pinned "101.2023". Any other value fails closed with a single EDITION violation.

payload.description: The zero-PII skeleton payload: originator, beneficiary, originatingVASP, beneficiaryVASP, transferPath and payloadMetadata entities. Every free-text leaf is "SYNTHETIC" or a {"len": n} marker; enumeration leaves carry real code values.

items.description: Person component: exactly one of naturalPerson or legalPerson, plus accountNumber values as SYNTHETIC markers.
Person component, same shape as originator.

originatingVASP.description: Optional Person component for the originating VASP.

beneficiaryVASP.description: Optional Person component for the beneficiary VASP.

items.description: IntermediaryVASP: intermediaryVASP Person plus a sequence integer starting at 0 and uninterrupted (C12).

payloadMetadata.description: payloadVersion (101 or 101.2023) and optional transliterationMethod script codes.

mcp_tool_definition.name: validate_ivms101_skeleton
mcp_tool_definition.description: Validate an IVMS 101.2023 travel-rule payload supplied as a zero-PII skeleton: required entities, cardinality, max lengths via len markers, pinned code-list membership, edition fail-closed, and constraints C1-C12 including the mutually exclusive natural-person and legal-person branches. Refuses any free-text leaf other than SYNTHETIC or a len marker, reporting the JSON path only and never echoing the value.

input_schema_provenance: ivms101_edition and payload are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads; the payload entity fields follow the pinned IVMS 101.2023 structures in their zero-PII skeleton form.
